seo.description: Visit Asilah’s whitewashed art medina: street murals, blue shutters, quiet alleys and the creative heart of this Atlantic town.
seo.og_description: Visit Asilah’s whitewashed art medina: street murals, blue shutters, quiet alleys and the creative heart of this Atlantic town.

name: Art Medina of Asilah
hero_subtitle: Whitewashed alleys, open-air murals and iron balconies — the creative heart of Asilah on the Atlantic.

overview.title: A medina painted as a gallery
overview.p1: Asilah’s medina is known for its annual arts festival, when artists refresh murals on the white walls. Even outside festival season the alleys feel like an open-air gallery.
overview.p2: Unlike busier medinas further south, Asilah stays calm. You can walk, photograph and stop for mint tea without constant pressure.
overview.p3: Morning light is soft on the whitewash; late afternoon brings warmer tones and more local life near the gates.

q1.question: Is the medina free?
q1.answer: Yes. No ticket; it is a living neighbourhood.

q3.question: Is it safe?
q3.answer: Yes. Compact and calm by day.

q5.question: When are murals refreshed?
q5.answer: Mainly during the summer Cultural Moussem.
